battle.name: 塔吉克斯坦內戰
battle.brief: 塔吉克斯坦內戰於一九九二年五月在杜尚別爆發，聯邦政府軍與反對派武裝在城市及周邊交火，是蘇聯解體後中亞地區的一場內戰。英國海軍的正式型號「蒸汽鐵甲艦（Steam ironclad）」於一八六五年開始服役，屬於較此衝突早二十七年已納入裝備體系的海上艦型。

kit.name: 蒸汽鐵甲艦
kit.history: 蒸汽鐵甲艦是英國皇家海軍早期將蒸汽動力與鐵甲防護結合的海上作戰艦種，負責巡弋、封鎖與岸轟，並在艦隊中承擔主力遠洋及接舷作戰任務。

countries: 1992年是塔吉克斯坦內戰最密集的決戰期，而不是整場戰爭的終點。交戰主體是塔吉克斯坦政府與反對陣營：政府一方包括總統府警衛、內務部隊、仍效忠中央的塔吉克陸軍，以及受中央指揮的北方地方軍；反對一方以伊斯蘭復興黨為核心，聯合民主聯盟、人民陣線和南部、北部的地方武裝。俄羅斯第201摩托化步兵師駐紮杜尚別，提供基地、空軍與防空掩護，也構成中央軍可使用的補給樞紐；烏茲別克斯坦站在拉赫蒙政府一方，以邊境管制和後勤支援切斷若干北方武裝的退路。戰區被杜尚別至庫洛布、卡萊庫姆布及霍魯格的山地公路，以及通往捷爾梅茲的鐵路切成數段，渡口、山口和公路樞紐因此直接決定彈藥、燃油與增援能否送達。
countriesEn: The year 1992 was the densest decisive phase of the Tajik Civil War, not the end of the entire conflict. The principal belligerents were the government of Tajikistan and an opposition coalition. On the government side were the Presidential Guard, Internal Troops, elements of the Tajik army still loyal to the central command, and northern local formations under central control. The opposition was centered on the Islamic Renaissance Party and included the Democratic Union, the Popular Front, and armed local groups from both the south and the north. Russia’s 201st Motor Rifle Division was stationed at Dushanbe, providing a base, air support, air defense, and a logistics hub usable by the central government. Uzbekistan supported the government led by Rahmon, using border controls and logistical assistance to restrict the retreat routes of some northern armed groups. The theater was divided by the mountain roads linking Dushanbe with Kulob, Kalai-Khumb, and Khorugh, and by the railway from Dushanbe to Termez. Consequently, possession of crossings, passes, and road junctions directly determined whether ammunition, fuel, and reinforcements could reach the front.
people: 1992年的指揮關係由數個彼此不信任的軍事集團構成。總統賈博爾·拉蘇洛夫在五月二日解除總理法伊祖洛·胡多耶夫內閣，五月六日杜尚別戒嚴後仍勉強維持政府，但到九月十日烏盧格貝格·多尼亞羅夫發動政變時，他與一批軍政人員已離開首都。埃莫馬利·拉赫蒙於六月二日出任總理，隨後以總統府警衛、北方陸軍與第201軍事基地提供的條件重建中央武裝；國防部長伊斯坎德爾·伊斯坎德羅夫是早期反攻的重要策劃者。胡多耶夫於十月六日與伊斯坎德羅夫在直昇機墜毀事件中身亡。伊斯蘭復興黨的政治領袖阿卜杜洛容·尤爾多舍夫與軍事首領塔希爾·尤爾達舍夫分掌政治組織和南部軍隊；前者參與談判，後者指揮前線。總統府警衛指揮官舍拉利·海魯拉耶夫則成為政府方面的重要戰場指揮者。多尼亞羅夫原為塔吉克蘇維埃社會主義共和國領導人兼杜尚別市長，九月政變失敗後北逃並與北方武裝首領賈姆希德·卡里莫夫合作。卡里莫夫曾多次改變陣線，顯示政府、伊斯蘭復興黨與北方軍團之間的聯盟會隨眼前威脅而變動。
peopleEn: The command structure in 1992 was divided among several mutually distrusting military groups. President Jabbor Rasulov dismissed Prime Minister Faizullo Khudoyberdiev’s cabinet on May 2 and managed to preserve the government after martial law was imposed in Dushanbe on May 6, but by the time Ulugh Beg Doniyorov launched his coup on September 10, Rasulov and several senior political and military officials had already left the capital. Emomali Rahmon became prime minister on June 2 and used the Presidential Guard, northern army units, and support available through the 201st Military Base to rebuild central military power. Defense Minister Iskander Iskanderov was an important planner of the early counteroffensive. Khudoyberdiev and Iskanderov were killed in a helicopter crash on October 6. Islamic Renaissance Party political leader Abdullojon Yuldoshev and military leader Tahir Yuldashev divided responsibilities between political organization and the southern forces; the former participated in negotiations while the latter commanded frontline units. Sherali Khayrullaev, commander of the Presidential Guard, became an important field commander for the government. Doniyorov, formerly a leader of the Tajik Soviet Socialist Republic and mayor of Dushanbe, fled north after the failed September coup and joined the northern commander Jamshed Karimov. Karimov repeatedly shifted his alignment, demonstrating that alliances among the government, the Islamic Renaissance Party, and the northern military groups changed according to the immediate threat.
kits: 雙方都可使用蘇聯時期留下的真實武器系統，但裝備完整性與配給方式不同。政府正規序列配備AKM、1959年列裝的AKM步槍、1974年列裝的AK-74突擊步槍、1969年列裝的PKM通用機槍、1961年列裝的RPG-7火箭筒，以及手槍、衝鋒槍和輕型反裝甲武器。反對軍從南部軍械庫取得步槍、機槍、迫擊炮與同型裝甲車，部分單位也由外部取得彈藥。D-30 122毫米榴炮、1972年列裝的2S1 Gvozdika 120毫米自行迫擊炮及1980年量產的2S3 Akatsiya 152毫米自行榴炮，使政府能以砲兵掩護公路和城鎮；反軍即使繳獲這些火炮，仍受制於駕駛、觀瞄具、維修零件和連續射擊所需的高消耗炮彈。1973年列裝的T-72坦克與1974年列裝的BTR-70裝甲步兵車主要在河谷公路投入，其他道路則依靠1967年列裝的Ural-375D卡車、1971年列裝的UAZ-469越野車與摩托化步兵分隊。塔吉克空軍序列中的MiG-21與Su-25負責空中偵察及對地支援，俄軍基地則有Mi-8和Mi-24直升機。5.45毫米、7.62毫米、40毫米火箭彈以及120毫米、122毫米、152毫米炮彈的補給線，決定了上述武器能連續作戰多久。
kitsEn: Both sides could use real Soviet-era weapon systems, although their equipment was distributed differently. Government regular formations held AKM assault rifles, AK-74 assault rifles introduced in 1974, PKM general-purpose machine guns introduced in 1969, RPG-7 rocket launchers introduced in 1961, as well as pistols, submachine guns, and light antiarmor weapons. Opposition forces seized rifles, machine guns, mortars, and wheeled armored vehicles from southern arsenals, while some units also received ammunition from outside the country. D-30 122 mm howitzers, 2S1 Gvozdika 120 mm self-propelled mortars introduced in 1972, and 2S3 Akatsiya 152 mm self-propelled howitzers produced from 1980 allowed the government to support roads and towns with artillery. Even when the opposition captured such guns, its ability to use them was restricted by the availability of drivers, sights, spare parts, and the large quantities of ammunition required for sustained fire. T-72 tanks introduced in 1973 and BTR-70 armored infantry fighting vehicles introduced in 1974 were committed mainly on valley roads. Elsewhere, movement depended on Ural-375D trucks introduced in 1967, UAZ-469 off-road vehicles introduced in 1971, and motorized infantry companies on foot. The Tajik air order included MiG-21 and Su-25 aircraft for reconnaissance and ground support, while the Russian base fielded Mi-8 and Mi-24 helicopters. Supply lines for 5.45 mm, 7.62 mm, and 40 mm ammunition and for 120 mm, 122 mm, and 152 mm shells determined how long these systems could remain in continuous combat.
tactics: 五月的開戰由政治危機直接轉成槍口衝突。胡多耶夫內閣被撤換後，伊斯蘭復興黨及其武裝支持者要求重新分配權力，並在杜尚別集結。五月五日，雙方槍戰擴展到政府機關、中央電視台與主要路口；政府於五月六日宣布緊急狀態，總統府警衛和內務部隊以裝甲車封鎖通往政府區與機場的道路。反對武裝沒有集中成一個大縱隊，而是分批控制市區南部入口，並從塔吉克軍南部營區取得武器和車輛。五月十日至十一日前後，圖爾松佐達落入反對軍手中；五月十三日至十四日前後，庫洛布也失守，公路與通往捷爾梅茲的鐵路因此中斷。政府軍保住杜尚別，卻無法立即打通南部走廊。北面運來的部隊在主要路口展開，T-72與BTR-70以火力掩護步兵班，步槍手、PKM和RPG-7則分置路旁與居民區制高點。反對軍避開正面坦克射界，以分散小組襲擊車隊和砲兵陣地；政府軍的裝甲縱隊不得不減慢速度，改由步兵、工兵和後方迫擊炮護衛。即使首都仍在政府手中，南部國軍整建崩解、補給線中斷與山地交通不足，已使五月的正面優勢無法迅速轉成全國控制。
tacticsEn: The conflict in May turned directly from a political crisis into gunfire. After Khudoyberdiev’s cabinet was dismissed, the Islamic Renaissance Party and its armed supporters demanded a redistribution of power and assembled in Dushanbe. Fighting on May 5 spread around government offices, the central television center, and major intersections. On May 6 the government declared a state of emergency, while the Presidential Guard and Internal Troops used armored vehicles to seal roads leading to the government quarter and the airfield. The opposition did not form one large column. It moved in separate groups through the southern entrances to the city and obtained weapons and vehicles from Tajik army barracks in the south. Tursunzoda fell to the opposition around May 10 to 11, and Kulob fell around May 13 to 14, cutting the road and railway to Termez. The government retained Dushanbe but could not immediately reopen the southern corridor. Troops brought from the north deployed at major junctions, with T-72 tanks and BTR-70 vehicles covering infantry squads, while riflemen, PKM gunners, and RPG-7 teams occupied positions beside roads and on elevated ground within the built-up area. The opposition avoided the frontal fire arcs of the tanks and used dispersed groups to strike supply columns and artillery positions. Government armored formations consequently reduced speed and relied on infantry, engineers, and rear-area mortars for protection. Even with the capital still held, the disintegration of southern army units, the severed supply lines, and inadequate mountain transport prevented the May advantage from becoming nationwide control.
data: 六月二日拉赫蒙出任總理後，六月至八月的主要行動集中在三條軸線：杜尚別至圖爾松佐達的西向公路、由沙阿爾圖茲通向庫洛布的河谷走廊，以及從庫洛布經卡萊庫姆布再越過山口通往霍魯格的後方道路。政府軍試圖以T-72和BTR-70裝甲群引導摩托化步兵，2S1與2S3提供曲射火力，卡車分批運送122毫米與152毫米炮彈；反軍則退入山脊和峽谷，以RPG-7打擊縱隊前車，並用繳獲的迫擊炮封鎖公路。每次推進都要先修復橋梁、補充燃油並重新建立彈藥卸載點，因此連續作戰受到補給速度限制。九月十日，多尼亞羅夫利用中央軍隊分化，控制廣播與政府機關，迫使拉蘇洛夫及部分軍政人員離開杜尚別。政府以北方正規軍、總統府警衛和裝甲部隊反攻，第201軍事基地提供防空與機場保障，但俄軍直接參加地面戰的具體次數在公開資料中並不一致。到九月二十二日前後，政府軍重新進入杜尚別，多尼亞羅夫北逃至庫簡德一帶並與卡里莫夫會合。此後政府與伊斯蘭復興黨武裝建立有限協同，集中兵力沿杜尚別至庫簡德公路對付北方集團，使南部反軍暫時無法同時向兩面施壓。十月以後政府控制首都、北部主要公路和多個城市，反對軍則退守南部山區與零散據點；一九九二年的攻勢至此停止，但雙方都沒有取得能單獨終止戰爭的決定性戰果。
dataEn: After Rahmon became prime minister on June 2, operations from June through August centered on three axes: the road west from Dushanbe to Tursunzoda, the valley corridor through Shahrtuz to Kulob, and the rear route from Kulob through Kalai-Khumb and across the passes to Khorugh. Government formations tried to lead motorized infantry with groups of T-72 tanks and BTR-70 vehicles, supported by 2S1 and 2S3 guns firing at long range, while trucks carried 122 mm and 152 mm shells in batches. The opposition withdrew onto ridges and into ravines, used RPG-7 launchers against the leading vehicles of convoys, and employed captured mortars to block the roads. Every advance required bridges to be repaired, fuel replenished, and ammunition unloading points re-established, so the speed of logistics limited the duration of continuous operations. On September 10 Doniyorov exploited divisions within the central army, took control of the broadcasting and government offices, and forced Rasulov and several senior officials to leave Dushanbe. The government counterattacked with regular northern troops, the Presidential Guard, and armored formations, while the 201st Military Base provided air defense and airfield support, although public accounts differ on the number of direct Russian ground operations. By approximately September 22 government forces had re-entered Dushanbe. Doniyorov fled north toward Khujand and joined Karimov. The government and Islamic Renaissance Party armed groups then established limited coordination, concentrating forces along the Dushanbe-Khujand road against the northern faction and preventing southern opposition units from pressing both fronts at once. From October onward the government held the capital, the principal northern roads, and several cities, while opposition forces remained in southern mountain areas and scattered strongholds. The offensives of 1992 ended at that point, but neither side achieved a decisive result capable of ending the war by itself.
cause: 內戰的直接引爆點是一九九二年五月二日拉蘇洛夫解除胡多耶夫內閣，但根源是一九九一年八月武裝政變後未解決的權力與軍隊問題。伊斯蘭復興黨曾進入政府並釋放一批因前共產派鎮壓而遭羈押的反對者，舊軍系重新掌握國家機關後，協議、審訊與政治責任從未徹底處理，軍隊和地方指揮官也因安全機關與民族構成問題持續分裂。胡多耶夫原本企圖以內閣改組和權力分享吸收部分反對力量，五月撤換反而使議會、政府與伊斯蘭復興黨同時失去可操作的妥協中心。反對陣營以武裝佔領市區和南部城鎮來擴大政治要求，政府則以戒嚴、總統府警衛、正規軍與外來援助維持秩序；當南部軍區成批倒向反對陣營，原本局限於首都的政治衝突便沿公路與鐵路擴展成全國性的軍Government斷裂。
causeEn: The immediate trigger was President Rasulov’s dismissal of Khudoyberdiev’s cabinet on May 2, 1992, but the roots lay in unresolved questions of power and military command following the armed coup of August 1991. The Islamic Renaissance Party had briefly entered the government and released opponents detained after repression by the former communist leadership. Once the old military network regained control of the state institutions, the agreements, trials, and political responsibility surrounding that conflict were never fully resolved. Divisions within the army and local commands were also intensified by rivalry involving the security organs and the ethnic composition of the forces. Khudoyberdiev had attempted to absorb part of the opposition through a reshuffled cabinet and a power-sharing arrangement. The May dismissal instead removed the last workable compromise center from the parliament, the government, and the Islamic Renaissance Party. The opposition expanded its political demands by occupying parts of the capital and southern towns, while the government relied on martial law, the Presidential Guard, regular troops, and outside assistance to preserve the state. When southern military districts defected in groups to the opposition, a political conflict that had been concentrated in the capital expanded along roads and railways into a nationwide rupture between the government and armed challengers.
impact: 一九九二年留下的影響不是一場能立即終止的殲滅戰，而是一次重新排列權力的長期軍政轉折。多尼亞羅夫於一九九三年四月三十日被政府軍在突擊中擊斃，北部卡里莫夫集團也隨後失去主要據點；同年七月，前公安與退伍軍人首領胡卓恩·圖爾蘇諾夫又在庫簡德發動武裝起事，短暫占據市區，數日後被政府軍逐退。這些事件證明首都與主要公路受控制，並不等於地方軍團已全部瓦解。政府在南部據點逐步收回後，吸收繳獲的槍炮、整建砲兵與空中單位，並以更高的中央調度限制地方指揮官；反對軍則把殘餘兵力轉入山區，保留小隊游擊和重新集結的能力。政治上，伊斯蘭復興黨的軍事失敗沒有立即帶來組織消失，反而使其部分成員回到議會與合法政黨路線。政府與反對方的武器來源、戰略目標和對北方軍團的共同顧慮，促使一九九三年以後出現有限停火與談判，而第201軍事基地及烏茲別克邊境通道仍使中央軍在後勤上維持對北方邊疆的影響。
impactEn: The principal effect of 1992 was not a decisive annihilation that ended the conflict, but a long military and political realignment. Doniyorov was killed by government forces during an assault on April 30, 1993, and the northern group associated with Karimov subsequently lost its principal strongholds. In July of the same year, former police and retired service commander Khodjon Tursunov launched another armed revolt in Khujand, briefly occupied parts of the city, and was driven out by government troops within days. These events demonstrated that control of the capital and main roads did not mean that all local military groups had been dismantled. As the government recovered southern positions, it absorbed seized weapons, expanded its artillery and aviation units, and strengthened central control over local commanders. The opposition retained the ability to place residual forces in mountain areas, operate in small detachments, and reassemble. Politically, the military defeat of the Islamic Renaissance Party did not immediately dissolve its organization, and some members later returned to parliamentary and legal party activity. The different weapons and strategic aims of the government and opposition, together with their shared concern over the northern military faction, encouraged limited ceasefires and negotiations after 1993. The 201st Military Base and the border routes through Uzbekistan also allowed the central government to retain logistical influence over the northern frontier.
result: 就一九九二年而言，軍事結果是政府保住杜尚別、控制主要城市與交通線，並迫使多尼亞羅夫北逃；反對陣營則失去對首都的控制，卻未被消滅，仍保有南部山區基地。因此，內戰的公開武裝階段一直延續到一九九七年的政治協議與停火。拉赫蒙於一九九四年十一月出任總統，一九九六年選舉後進一步集中行政權；政府與伊斯蘭復興黨代表的 opposition 於一九九七年一月三十日達成和解協議，安排赦免、 opposition 合法化及部分政治權力分配，聯合國觀察團在同年監督停火，至六月三十日前後公開戰鬥大致停止。結果是中央政府保住國家邊界與主要行政中心，伊斯蘭復興黨轉為合法反對力量，而北部地方軍團未能形成持續分離的政權。各方與國際來源對一九九二年至一九九七年的傷亡總數使用不同口徑，部分戰報亦把作戰、處決、失事與後續衝突混列，缺乏可核實的統一數字，因此本紀錄不填入未經證實的精確傷亡總量。
resultEn: For 1992 itself, the military result was that the government retained Dushanbe, controlled the principal cities and transport lines, and forced Doniyorov to flee north. The opposition lost control of the capital but was not eliminated and retained bases in the southern mountains. Consequently, the public armed phase of the civil war continued until a political agreement and ceasefire in 1997. Rahmon became president in November 1994 and further centralized executive authority after the 1996 election. The government and the opposition represented by the Islamic Renaissance Party reached a reconciliation agreement on January 30, 1997, providing for amnesty, the legalization of opposition activity, and a measure of political power-sharing, while United Nations observers monitored the ceasefire later that year. By approximately June 30, open fighting had largely stopped. The central government retained the national borders and principal administrative centers, the Islamic Renaissance Party became a legal opposition force, and the northern local military factions failed to establish a durable separatist government. Government, opposition, and international accounts use different methods for calculating total casualties between 1992 and 1997, and some battle reports combine combat deaths, executions, aircraft accidents, and later fighting without providing verifiable totals. This account therefore does not insert an unverified precise casualty figure.
